title: Without Delete, a user can still rename a part stocked at two locations
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919); the Admin role has 'Part Library & Inventory → View', 'Part Library & Inventory → Create & Edit' and 'Part Library & Inventory → Delete' and can see costs and prices.
  • Staff member {User-B} (for example ZZAUTOTEST PL-NODEL-RENAME) works at {Location-A} with the custom role {Role-B} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-NODEL-RENAME-ROLE), which has 'Part Library & Inventory → View', 'Part Library & Inventory → Create & Edit' and See Financial Data but not 'Part Library & Inventory → Delete'.
  • {User-B} is signed in in a second browser window (for example a private window), and the Admin stays signed in in the first window.
  • Location {Location-B} (for example ZZAUTOTEST PL RENAME LOC 2) is a second location created for this case.
  • Inventory part {Part-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-NODEL-RENAME-01, described ZZAUTOTEST PL RENAME OLD) is stocked at both {Location-A} and {Location-B} on the same Part Library entry.
  • The new description {Description-B} (for example ZZAUTOTEST PL RENAME NEW) is not used by any part.
  • Parts → Inventory is open on the Active tab at {Location-A} in {User-B}'s window.
custom_steps:
1. In {User-B}'s window search {Part-A} and click its row.
  2. Replace the Description with {Description-B}.
  3. Read the text under the Description field.
  4. Click Save.
  5. In the Admin window pick {Location-B} in the location switcher and open Parts → Inventory.
  6. Search {Part-A}.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 3: Under the field: "This also changes the description at 1 other location."
  • Step 4: The dialog closes and the change is saved; no access error appears, although {User-B} has no Delete and the change reaches {Location-B}.
  • Step 6: At {Location-B}, {Part-A} now reads {Description-B}.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; story SV-10821 (Story 8, Permissions); PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, v29 (14 Oct 2026 copy), S8-R11, S13-R12, read 14 Oct 2026; design canvas boards 2.2 (Both fields edited) and 2.5 (Lethbridge: renamed there too), correct-note-5, 13 Oct copy, unchanged on 14 Oct. Source-verified 14 October 2026; not yet build-verified (no Part Lifecycle QA build exists).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S8-R11: “Changing a part's number or description needs only the 'Part Library & Inventory → Create & Edit' permission, including when the change reaches other locations.”
  • S13-R12: “When the user changes the description and at least one other location stocks the same Part Library entry, the dialog shows, under the field, "This also changes the description at {n} other locations.", or "This also changes the description at 1 other location." for one.”
